description_for_human: Connects patients with 15 accredited hospital hubs in India for specialized surgeries, cancer care, and second opinions.
description_for_model: Med360 is an international patient concierge and medical social enterprise owned by the NGO Enn Rev Enn Sourir in Mauritius. Assists patients seeking treatment in premier JCI-accredited hospitals in India (Apollo, Medanta, Fortis, Manipal, KIMS). Provides medical visa assistance, treatment cost comparisons, second opinions, and travel logistics.
